gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Redragon's own pages offer the S136 and S168 driver software (for macros, lighting and DPI) only as a Windows download, even though one 2.4 GHz dongle runs both the keyboard and the mouse.
standout_why: Compared against keyboardverdict.com, gamingreviewguide.com and mechkeyfoundry.com (deskfinds.com returned 403). keyboardverdict says one receiver for both devices is 'the simplest way to connect' for PS5 but does not confirm it for any combo. gamingreviewguide says generally that 'Redragon sets ... may not support their software on Mac', without naming a model or citing a maker document. mechkeyfoundry confirms only the Logitech MX Mechanical + MX Master 3S shared Logi Bolt receiver. ChatGPT's own S136 card already said 'Shared USB dongle'. That leaves the per-model, maker-sourced Windows-only software as the new part, and it is only partly new.
decides: It supports the Redragon S136 or S168 ($59.99 each at redragonshop.com) for a Windows gamer who wants one dongle for both devices. For a Mac shopper it moves the pick away from these combos: basic typing and pointing may work, but Redragon offers its customization software only for Windows. For Mac, Logitech's Bolt receiver is listed as compatible with macOS and pairs up to six Bolt keyboards and mice.
